Application Data.NAME: Clearview Glass & Window Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Clearview Glass & Window Services specializes in the installation, repair, and maintenance of residential and commercial glass and window products. Our team of trained professionals provides expert services including custom glass fabrication, window replacement, and emergency board-up services. We are committed to quality workmanship and customer satisfaction, ensuring that each project meets the highest standards. With a focus on energy-efficient solutions, we also offer consultations on upgrading existing windows to enhance property value and efficiency.

The claim is currently in progress and pending approval. On 06/22/2023, a customer reported a minor injury while our team was performing window repairs, resulting in medical expenses totaling $1,000. This incident has been resolved amicably without further claims.
